summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError and parse_shacl_path, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes plus a plain-string input test. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass (40 passed) under the prepared venv. Nothing was committed and no existing files were modified. mypy and ruff are not installed in the venv, so the type-check and lint gates were checked by reading only; all lines are within 88 columns.
